items.title: Follow-up failed; nothing was sent
items.reason_text: The mail system refused; nothing was sent.

items.title: Follow-up did not finish
items.reason_text: The follow-up did not finish and the desk has no confirmation. The email may have left. Retry is safe only when the mail system keeps a key for repeats (a keyed outbox); otherwise check the mail system first.

items.title: Follow-up failed; a person marked the email as not sent
items.reason_text: A person checked and marked that the email was not sent. Retry sends it now. If you are not sure it did not go out, check the mail system first.

items.title: UNKNOWN: the email may or may not have gone out
items.reason_text: An earlier send may have left after a stop; the desk will not send again blind.

confirm.title: Mark the email as sent?
confirm.body: This cannot be undone. The desk will never send this follow-up again.

actions.label: I checked: it was not sent

confirm.title: Mark the email as not sent?
confirm.body: If the email did go out and the mail system cannot recognise repeats, a Retry will send a second email. Check the mail system first.

items.hint: The CRM may or may not hold this lead. Look in the CRM, then answer crm_present (the row is there: Retry goes straight to the email) or not_sent (the row is not there: Retry asks the CRM again). sent is refused here: no email was ever tried. not_sent: an extra CRM row may need deleting by hand.
items.title: UNKNOWN: the CRM may or may not hold this lead
items.reason_text: The CRM may or may not hold this lead.

confirm.title: Confirm the CRM row is there?
confirm.body: Retry will then go straight to the email.

actions.label: The CRM row is not there

confirm.title: Mark the CRM row as missing?
confirm.body: Retry will ask the CRM again; if a row was there, delete the extra one by hand.

items.title: Incomplete request: email is missing
items.reason_text: Send a corrected submission with a NEW request id.

items.hint: The desk itself could not decide this receipt (a fault on the desk side, not in the request). A person must look at the desk log. Sending a new request id is not the fix.
items.title: The desk could not decide this request
items.reason_text: The desk itself could not decide this receipt (a fault on the desk side, not in the request). A person must look at the desk log. Sending a new request id is not the fix.

items.title: Queued longer than 120 s
items.reason_text: The desk retries by itself; Retry starts it now.

items.title: Sending longer than 120 s
items.reason_text: The desk puts it back by itself after the send timeout.

items.title: Request received, no verdict for longer than 120 s
items.reason_text: Send the same request id again, or restart the desk.

items.title: Same request id sent again with different data; the first answer stands
